defillama_dex.semantics: on-chain DEX activity, NOT exchange flows

defillama_stablecoins.availability_rule: daily bucket start + 24h (a day's value is complete only after the day ends)
defillama_stablecoins.instrument: all stablecoins / USDT / USDC / chain totals
defillama_stablecoins.v1_overlap: none (V1 'global' is total crypto market cap, not stablecoin supply)

defillama_tvl.instrument: DeFi TVL (all chains, and per chain)

deribit_dvol.availability_rule: candle timestamp + 1 interval (the close is final at the end of the hour)
deribit_dvol.rate_limit: non-matching-engine credit pool (~20 requests / s sustained)
deribit_dvol.v1_overlap: none: V1 has no implied-volatility source

deribit_options_history.reason: Historical options open interest, put/call ratio and max pain are not provided by the free API (only the current book). They are not reconstructed or fabricated.

deribit_options_snapshot.availability_rule: retrieval time (live snapshot; never usable for a past timestamp)
deribit_options_snapshot.history: LIVE ONLY: the API returns the current book; no historical options OI, put/call or max pain exists for free

exchange_flows.reason: Genuine exchange inflow/outflow needs exchange wallet labelling (CryptoQuant, Glassnode, Nansen): paid or key-gated. DeFiLlama stablecoin/DEX data is NOT a substitute and is not labelled as flows.

gdelt_doc.availability_rule: article seendate (first seen by GDELT) + 15 min
gdelt_doc.history: ROLLING LAST ~3 MONTHS only (DOC 2.0 search window)
gdelt_doc.pagination: ArtList max 250 articles per call (split by time window)
gdelt_doc.rate_limit: GDELT asks for at most one request every 5 seconds
gdelt_doc.resolution: 15 min timelines for short spans; article seen-dates to the minute

run.note: ArtList capped at 250 articles per topic per window

gdelt_doc.unit: article counts; normalised = per monitored articles
gdelt_doc.v1_overlap: partly overlaps V1 news sources (cryptonews, geopolitics, sosovalue headlines) as text-volume, not as scores

gdelt_events.availability_rule: batch time + 15 min (frozen GDELT component lag); event date (SQLDATE) is day-level only

hyperliquid_btc_funding.dimension: SAME INSTRUMENT AS AN EXISTING V1 SOURCE
hyperliquid_btc_funding.v1_overlap: V1 funding/longshort read the same venue's current funding (HYPERLIQUID_LEVERAGE_STRESS.md)

hyperliquid_hip3.dimension: MIXED: GOLD/BRENTOIL/EUR are V1 instruments; SP500/XYZ100/10Y are higher-resolution versions of V1 dimensions; SILVER/COPPER are new
hyperliquid_hip3.history: 1h back ~208 days (rolling); HIP-3 macro perps listed Dec 2025-Aug 2026
hyperliquid_hip3.instrument: BTC, xyz:SP500, xyz:XYZ100, xyz:GOLD, xyz:SILVER, xyz:COPPER, xyz:BRENTOIL, xyz:EUR, para:10Y
hyperliquid_hip3.pagination: 500 rows per call; only the most recent 5,000 candles per interval
hyperliquid_hip3.v1_overlap: see HYPERLIQUID_ASSET_UNIVERSE.md: oil=xyz:BRENTOIL, usd=xyz:EUR, gold=xyz:GOLD in V1; sp500/nasdaq/yield10y are FRED daily in V1

liquidations_exchange_rest.reason: Neither exchange offers free historical liquidation data over REST: Binance's public forceOrders history endpoint was withdrawn, and Bybit/Binance publish liquidations only on live WebSocket streams. That supports prospective collection only, which is out of scope here.

liquidations_xoomar.reason: No public 'Xoomar' endpoint could be identified: not referenced anywhere in the CryptoPulse repositories and not found by web search. Needs the exact URL from the requester. No substitute used.

lth_flows.reason: Long-term-holder supply/flows need UTXO-age analytics (Glassnode, CryptoQuant): paid. Further source research required.

miner_flows.reason: Miner-to-exchange flows need miner address labelling (paid providers). Free mempool.space / blockchain.com data covers hashrate, fees and pool block counts, which are miner ACTIVITY, not flows, and are not substituted.

whale_flows.reason: Entity-labelled whale flows need address clustering (Glassnode, CryptoQuant, Arkham, Whale Alert history): paid or key-gated. Further source research required.

v1_impact: NONE: research data layer only. No score, no weights, no thresholds, no V1 change.
